title: I think I built a Wordle killer. And the world shall call it...WordChain!
author: PhotographNo7254
selftext:
Play it here: [gamestovibe.com/wordchain](http://gamestovibe.com/wordchain)

Create words using common characters from the previous word. The more the number of common characters, the higher the score. The more complex the word, the higher the score. It's that simple.

You have 3 minutes and 10 words. Tick tock.

Get on the leaderboard and earn bragging rights :-D

PS: I welcome your feedback, bug reports and ideas to improve the game play.

Current limitation: I am using a custom 900kb dictionary so there may be times when a word that rightfully belongs to the board gets rejected. I am trying actively to find a fix for this without building huge word lists. Will keep you updated.

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: I'm afraid much more than I anticipated bud. Lots of iterations - especially getting the animations running smoothly on mobile devices and the database of words. Kinda doesn't work the first time so you gotta keep experimenting till it's acceptable.

comments.author: yanenrogne
comments.body:
Looks pretty fun! Would fit right in the reddit games library.

One caveat I'm thinking though, if you're thinking about replayability of the game, once you get a good chain of words, nothing prevents you of using it every time 🤔

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: Very fair point. And that's probably where the leaderboard kind of pushes you to outdo yourself you know. So you get a high score, someone else outdoes it and then you need to get more creative the next time. What do you think?

replies.author: VampyrAvenger
replies.body: Are you able to actually use the same word more than once? Limiting it to one word one time regardless would be much better I think!

replies.author: PhotographNo7254
replies.body: No we reject the same word as well as the variations. So if you use infect, then automatically infected and infecting are not available anymore.

replies.author: VampyrAvenger
replies.body: Oh that's great, I'd def try this out for ya!
